plan.notes: Source: official 2026-2027 University of Colorado Boulder undergraduate catalog page 'Psychology - Bachelor of Arts (BA)' (Department of Psychology and Neuroscience). Transcribed from the catalog's 'Recommended Four-Year Plan of Study' grid, cross-checked against the catalog-generated program PDF (two-column layout; rows verified against published per-semester credit totals). This is a sample plan: the catalog notes other pathways are possible depending on the timing of the PSYC 2111/3111 sequence. Plan total 120 credit hours matches the catalog's published plan total of 120 (120-122 range: the MATH ancillary course carries 3-5 credits depending on the course chosen; recorded at the 3-credit minimum per convention, so the plan total is the 120 minimum). Major requires minimum 36 psychology credit hours (at least 20 upper-division incl. 10 at the 4000 level), a laboratory and methods course, and 4 of the 5 required courses (PSYC 2012, 2145, 2606, 3102, 3303). Ancillary natural science sequence examples are EBIO 1210/1220; other approved sequences are listed in the catalog.
